hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: Bonding-curve launchpad hook that manages the full token lifecycle: blocks external pool/liquidity operations, enforces a fixed-range bonding curve selling 75% of supply, collects a 1% afterSwap fee (split 50/50 between creator and platform), and upon graduation removes bonding-curve liquidity and initialises a new AMM pool seeded with the remaining 20% token supply and a configured base-token amount.
